chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Hammad al-Kufi, from Amr ibn Mus'ab, from Furat ibn al-Ahnaf, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Whatever you leave out of anything, do not leave out saying in every morning and evening: 'O Allah, I have reached morning seeking Your forgiveness in this morning and in this day for those deserving of Your mercy, and I disavow to You from those deserving of Your curse.'

O Allah, I have reached morning disavowing to You in this day and in this morning from those among whom we are, from the polytheists and from what they used to worship. Indeed, they were an evil people, wicked.
O Allah, make what You sent down from the sky to the earth in this morning and in this day a blessing upon Your friends and a punishment upon Your enemies.
O Allah, befriend the one who befriends You, and be enemy to the one who is enemy to You. O Allah, end for me with safety and faith every time the sun rises or sets.
O Allah, forgive me and my parents, and have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small.
O Allah, forgive the believing men and believing women, the Muslim men and Muslim women, the living among them and the dead.
O Allah, indeed You know their movements and their dwellings.
O Allah, protect the Imam of the Muslims with the protection of faith, and grant him a strong victory, and open for him an easy victory.
And make for him and for us from You a persistent helper.
O Allah, curse so-and-so and so-and-so, and the differing sects upon Your Messenger and the Masters of Command after Your Messenger and the Imams after him and their Shias.

And I ask You for increase from Your grace, and acknowledgment of what came from Your presence, and submission to Your command, and preservation of what You commanded with. I do not seek an exchange for it, nor sell it for a small price.

O Allah, guide me among those You guided, and save me from the evil of what You decreed. Indeed You decree and it is not decreed upon You, and he whom You befriend is not humiliated. Blessed and Exalted are You.
Glory be to You, Lord of the House. Accept from me my supplication and what I drew near to You with from goodness, and multiply it for me with a multiplied, great multiple.
And give us from You mercy and a great reward.
Lord, how excellent is what You tried me with, and how great is what You gave me, and how long is what You kept me healthy, and how much is what You veiled from me.
So for You is the praise, O my God, abundant, good, blessed upon it, the fullness of the heavens and the fullness of the earth and the fullness of what my Lord desired.
As He loves and is pleased with, and as it befits the Face of my Lord, the One of Majesty and Honor.
ai.seo_question: What is the content and significance of the morning and evening supplication from Imam al-Sadiq (AS)?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi*, this supplication exemplifies the Shia practice of *Tasbihat al-Fatimah* and daily *Du'a* rituals, emphasizing the interplay between personal piety and communal identity through *Tawalli* (affiliation) and *Tabarri* (disaffiliation). It integrates theological concepts of divine decree (*Qadr*) and the preservation of the *Imam* into the believer's routine, reflecting the jurisprudential emphasis on consistent remembrance (*Dhikr*) as a means of spiritual fortification.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Abdul Rahman Bin Hammad Al Kufy, from Amro Bin Mus’ab, from Furat Bin Al Ahnaf, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘From whatever you leave out from anything, so do not leave out saying during every morning and evening, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I come to be seeking Your<sup>azwj</sup> Forgiveness in this morning and in this day of those deserving of Your<sup>azwj</sup> Mercy, and disavow to You<sup>azwj</sup> from the ones deserving of Your<sup>azwj</sup> Curse.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I come to be disavowing from the ones we are among apparently, from the Polytheists and from whatever they are worshipping, to Your<sup>azwj</sup> (presence) during this day and during this morning. They were an evil people, wicked.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Make whatever You<sup>azwj</sup> Send down from the sky to the earth during this morning and during this day, to be a Blessing upon Your<sup>azwj</sup> friends, and a Punishment upon Your<sup>azwj</sup> enemies.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I befriend the one befriends You<sup>azwj</sup> and am an enemy to the one who is inimical to You<sup>azwj</sup>. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Cause it to end for me with the safety and the Eman every time the sun emerges or sets.
O Allahazwj! Forgive (my sins) for me, and for my parents, [17:24] Have Mercy upon them, as they brought me up (when I was) little.
O Allahazwj! Forgive (the sins of) the Momineen, and the Mominaat (female Believers), and the Muslim men and the Muslim women, the living ones from them and the deceased.
O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! You<sup>azwj</sup> Know their activities and their dwellings.
O Allahazwj! Protect the Imamasws of the Muslims with the protection of the Eman, and Help himasws with a Strong Help, and Grant an easy victory for himasws,
and Make for him<sup>asws</sup> and for us, from You<sup>azwj</sup>, a persistence helper’.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Curse so and so, and so and so, and the group which differed upon Your<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>, and the Masters<sup>asws</sup> of the Command after Your<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup> and the Imams<sup>asws</sup> from after him<sup>saww</sup>, and their<sup>asws</sup> Shias.

And I ask You<sup>azwj</sup> of the increase from Your<sup>azwj</sup> Grace, and the acknowledgement with whatever has come from Your<sup>azwj</sup> Presence, and the submission to Your<sup>azwj</sup> Command and the preservation upon whatever You<sup>azwj</sup> have Commanded with. I neither seek an exchange with it nor sell it for a little price.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Guide me among the ones You<sup>azwj</sup> Guided, and Save me from the evil of what You<sup>azwj</sup> have Ordained. You<sup>azwj</sup> Ordained and there is no Ordainment upon You<sup>azwj</sup>, nor would the one who befriends You<sup>azwj</sup> be humiliated. You<sup>azwj</sup> are Blessed and Exalted.

Glory be to You<sup>azwj</sup>, Lord<sup>azwj</sup> of the House (Kabah). Accept my supplication from me and what I can be closer to You<sup>azwj</sup> with from goodness, and Multiply it for me with a huge multiple,
and Give us from You<sup>azwj</sup>, Mercy and a great Recompense.

Lord<sup>azwj</sup>! How excellent is what You<sup>azwj</sup> Tried me with, and how great was what You<sup>azwj</sup> Gave me and Prolonged my good health, and how frequently You<sup>azwj</sup> Veiled upon me.
So, for You<sup>azwj</sup> is the Praise, O my God, abundant, good, Blessed upon the communities of the skies and the communities of the earth, and whatever my Lord<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires,
just as He<sup>azwj</sup> Loves, and is Pleased with, and just as it is befitting for the Face of my Lord<sup>azwj</sup>, the One with Majesty and the Benevolence’’.
en.sarwar: 23. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn Hammad al-Kufi from ‘Amr ibn Musa’B from Furat ibn al-Ahnaf from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

“You may give up whatever you give up but do not give up to say every morning and in the evening the following: “O Lord, this morning I seek forgiveness from You on this day for the people of kindness and disavow the people subject to Your condemnation.
“O Lord, this morning and on this day I disavow the pagans around us, and what they worship. They were an evil people.
“O Lord, this morning and on this day make everything that You will send from the sky to earth a blessing for Your friends and a punishment for Your enemies.
“O Lord, love those who love You and be the enemy of Your enemies.
“O Lord, finish for me every sunset and sunrise with peace and belief.
“O Lord, forgive my parents and me and be kind to them just as they were kind to me for bringing me up as a small person.
“O Lord, forgive the believing male and female, Muslim male and female, their living and their dead. O Lord, You know their activities and their dwellings.
“O Lord, protect the Imam of the Muslims with the protection of belief, grant him a powerful victory, easy conquest and assign for him and for us, from before You, a supportive authority.
“O Lord, condemn so and so and the groups who deferred against Your Messenger, people possessing Authority from You after Your Messenger, the A’immah after him and their Shi’a (followers).

I plead before You for more of Your generosity, to affirm whatever he (Your Messenger) has brought from You, submission to Your command, and to be protective of what You have commanded to follow. I do not want thereby any payment or to sell it for a little price.

“O Lord, guide me along with those whom You have granted guidance, spare me from the evil of whatever You have decided; You decide and no one can judge against You and no one who loves You is humiliated. You are blessed and high, glory belongs to You, Lord of the House, accept my prayer.
And the means through which I sought nearness to You, increase them for me several times and much more.
Grant us, from before You, favors and great rewards.

Lord, how good is the test that You placed me in, whatever great favors You have granted me and the long time that I enjoyed good health! How much is the cover with which You have covered up my faults!
All praise belongs to You, O Lord, a great deal, fine and blessed to the fill of the heavens and earth, to the fill of what my Lord wills
as He loves and consents, as it should be worthwhile of my Lord, the Possessor of glory and honor.’”
